Name: Sanjay Parikh
Designation: Executive Vice President and Member of the Board, Indegene
Bio:
Sanjay Parikh is a Founder of Plaksha. He is Executive Vice President and Member of the Board of Indegene. He has more than 25 years of experience in strategy, business development, and operations in the pharmaceutical, medical devices, and healthcare industries across most developed and developing markets.

He has a BTech degree in Electrical Engineering from IIT Bombay, a master's degree in Clinical Engineering from Case Western Reserve University, Cleveland, and a PhD in Biomedical Engineering from the Johns Hopkins University School of Medicine, Baltimore, MD. Sanjay has also been a visiting faculty member at the School of Biomedical Engineering of IIT Bombay.
